- n4 -- Charging infrastructure upgrades face transformer shortages -- vital
- n5 -- Electric bus recharge takes 10h at 50kW -- okay
- n6 -- Peak demand charges cost EV fleets over $250k/month -- vital
- n7 -- NEVI requires certified electricians, adding labor load -- vital
- n8 -- Average new car lead times hit 4‑12 weeks -- vital
- n9 -- Data‑driven fleet replacement based on age/mileage -- vital
- n10 -- Lifecycle cost analysis informs optimal swap timing -- vital
- n11 -- Standardizing models cuts parts inventory and repair time -- okay
- n12 -- Diversify vehicles for specific operational needs -- okay
- n13 -- Phased EV adoption: hybrids first, then full EVs -- vital
- n14 -- Leasing mitigates long lead‑time uncertainty -- vital
- n15 -- Include charging station and grid upgrade costs in budget -- vital
- n16 -- Telematics track usage and predict maintenance needs -- okay
- n17 -- Predictive maintenance reduces unscheduled downtime -- okay
- n18 -- Local EV incentive programs lower purchase cost -- vital
- n19 -- Optimal purchase timing depends on dealer stock -- vital
- n20 -- Battery warranty coverage offsets degradation risk -- vital
- n21 -- Transformer lead times now over one year -- vital
- n22 -- Public fleet must plan 5‑year lifecycle goals -- vital
